ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white/cream pixels (~75%) contrasted against low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central notch area and along the dorsal/trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones occupy the majority of both lateral lobes. A central low-intensity black region forms a bifurcated shape extending from the median notch. The right lobe contains a high-density cluster of dark pixels (mottling) in its upper-medial quadrant. Diffuse yellow-hued pixel clusters are visible across the lower-medial sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-point with a depth of approximately 12-15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Fine-grained, irregular serration along the horizontal trailing edge with higher amplitude peak-to-valley variations visible near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upper lobe boundaries that taper into a sharp downward/distal curve at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-intensity, multi-colored (white/pinkish) pixels at the extreme lateral tips consistent with external growth. Two distinct dark circular pixel clusters are located on the interior surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark vertical linear marks are visible on the upper-right lobe surface, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged silhouettes at the distal tips caused by dense calcified clusters; irregular dark staining/marking on the upper boundary of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive diffuse yellowish-brown pigmentation distributed non-uniformly across the ventral surface.
